collection.description: A healer's strong plant draught may dull pain during a difficult procedure, but may also slow breathing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer has prepared a strong plant draught that may dull pain during a difficult procedure but may also dangerously slow breathing.

choices.label: Offer the draught after explaining the uncertainty.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient feels little pain, but remains weak and difficult to wake.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient grows dangerously still, and the healers abandon the procedure to tend to breathing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient remains awake and frightened, but the procedure is completed.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The weaker draught does little, and the patient asks the healers to stop.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient agrees to wait while the healers seek a safer approach.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The delay allows the condition to worsen, forcing another difficult discussion.
